title: msg POST lacks OSCORE-or-admin gate
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py

Correctness/security: MessagesResource.render_post (line 191, mounted at /msg/inbox), LegacyMessagesAliasResource.render_post (line 400, /messages), and MessageReceiptsResource.render_post (line 344, /msg/ack) accept unauthenticated POSTs.

Firmware contract (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c:312, coap_msg.c:393 and 860) and test/vectors/coap_lci_auth.json vector inbox_mesh_peer_unauthorized require OSCORE or lichen_coap_is_local_admin; otherwise 4.01 Unauthorized. Dead-drop already implements this via _request_context_id.

Impact: any CoAP peer can inject inbox and sent records, fire Observe, spoof /msg/ack receipts, persist read=True to hide from unread_count, and POST id=2^64-1 to pin _next_id and fail-close auto-id (5.03) for the process lifetime.

SentMessagesResource.render_post (line 277) is the only path that checks _peer_is_local_admin; inbox and ack do not.
acceptance_criteria: POST /msg/inbox, POST /messages, and POST /msg/ack from a non-loopback, non-OSCORE peer return 4.01 and do not mutate inbox, sent, receipts, or _next_id. Loopback and OSCORE-protected peers still succeed per coap_lci_auth.json. Match firmware: oscore.is_protected || is_local_admin.
close_reason: Inbox/ack/legacy POST now require bound OSCORE identity or loopback admin before any mutation. Unauthenticated mesh POSTs return 4.01 and leave inbox, sent, receipts, and _next_id unchanged. Loopback and OSCORE-protected peers still succeed. pytest 391 passed, 179 skipped.
